climate_water_balance.aggregation: min(1, sum of best two joint seasonal scores / 1.6)
climate_water_balance.growing_months: sum of four joint seasonal scores times three; equivalent suitable months, not capped food support

rainfall_transport.annual_combine: arithmetic mean of four seasonal rates
rainfall_transport.cold_continent_weather_occupancy: up to 70 percent fewer moist frontal sectors; local weights normalized
rainfall_transport.cold_land_recycling: shared zonal temperature baseline, elevation and seasonal heating; -2 to 10 C evaporation ramp
rainfall_transport.lowland_basin_mixing: DEM-inferred closed below-sea-level lake basin; 600-1000 km taper, only where nearer than the ocean
rainfall_transport.marine_supply: Magnus saturation relative to 27 C, without a humidity floor
rainfall_transport.rainfall_units: estimated annual mm; quarterly fields are annualized rates
rainfall_transport.rules: seasonal ITCZ, subtropical dry-air exchange, westerlies, land-sea heating gradient, Coriolis deflection, stability/monsoon-limited mountain uplift, high-mountain rain shadow, SST moisture supply and advected cold marine inversion
rainfall_transport.sea_ice: temperature/latitude seasonal open-water proxy; no observed sea ice
rainfall_transport.water_classes: explicit 0 land / 1 ocean / 2 inland lake; no region masks

terrain_source.relief_title: SRTM15 Earth Relief v2.7 at 06 arc minutes

sources.description: GMT SRTM15+ v2.7, 6 arcminutes; 31.5 km full-width Gaussian filter

terrain_source.water_processing: Natural Earth land/lakes; Caspian land-hole component is a lake. Closed raster seas retain ocean class; subpixel straits are not assumed absent.
